name: Kimberly Richey
current_role: Assistant Secretary for Civil Rights, Department of Education (confirmed October 2025)
summary: Kimberly Richey, who served in the Office for Civil Rights in Trump’s first term, was confirmed 51–47 in October 2025 to lead it under Education Secretary Linda McMahon.
